Nadia —

Thanks. I put together a rotating-window proposal that should be predictable for everyone and simple for calendar invites. High-level:

- 4-session series, every other week, 90-minute deep dives.
- Rotation pattern by session: Week A = US-friendly, Week B = EU-friendly, Week C = APAC-friendly, Week D = neutral mid-range (compromise midday EU / late-afternoon US / early-morning APAC).
- Each session starts at the same UTC anchor and we rotate local times so no single region bears the overnight burden.

Attached: rotation_matrix_v2.xlsx (local time conversions + DST notes) and two .ics invite templates (one for US/EU/one for APAC).

Notes about DST: I accounted for the recent fall DST changes (US shifted Nov 7, EU Oct 31). The matrix flags sessions that cross the DST boundary and includes a one-week reminder to re-check local times before each invite.

Quick ask: please confirm participant list per session and whether any architect absolutely cannot attend any of the proposed windows. Once confirmed, we’ll publish invites and a public recording + summary doc after each session.

Best,
Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
